quotes.text: We still want to be a leader in AI. We don't want China to surpass us. The trick is really finding the right balance. I think there's going to be a lot of discussion on this front.

This is what I mean about Newsom. His worldview is totally distorted.  He is so clueless that he actually BELIEVES that a train project utilizing antiquated technology, that is billions of dollars over budget and behind schedule is the “key” to beating China?  That a bullet train to help urbanites zip through the on the way to LA will “help” the Central Valley instead of water and energy investments, cutting high utilities and gas costs, and fast tracking next-gen AI and other technology to leap past China. 

In fact, he is the one who has a long history of appeasing China, clearing out the homeless and rolling out the “red” carpet for them in SF last year.  It was a “thanks for stealing our technology” celebration.  

Meanwhile, he has hamstrung our economy, raised our cost of living beyond belief, and literally forced us to buy Chinese solar panels and electric vehicles.

Thank you Chairman Babin for the very nice welcome to the Science, Space & Technology committee. I am ready to get to work on the important work on AI, research and technology, and ensuring that America continues to lead in science and innovation. https://t.co/dBXUMTq5mn

Proud to continue my work protecting kids online. Today it was my honor to support and help pass the KIDS Act which provides for age verification, regulates AI chatbots, increases data protections and addresses drug sales on social media. 

Stronger protections for children, more tools for parents. Thank you @RepGuthrie for your leadership on this important bill.

For those suddenly talking about AI regulation, much of this work is already being done through a bipartisan work group led by California’s own Congressman @JayObernolte 

This House Majority is on it, with legislation moving forward, including several bills recently passing out of the Science Space & Technology committee that I am proud to serve on.

Human traffickers are using new technology to prey on innocent children, and we cannot allow the federal government to fall behind. These criminals are finding new ways to reach vulnerable victims, and our response needs to keep pace.

Whether it's happening online or in our own backyard, human trafficking is a horrific crime that demands action. The technology criminals use may change, but our responsibility to protect the innocent does not.
